# LX-N Music Aurora 1.8.85-aurora.3

[简体中文](#简体中文) | [English](#english)

## 简体中文

这是基于 <code>souvenp/lx-netease-music-mobile</code> 的非官方 Aurora 维护版。

### 本次内容

- 修复播放详情歌词在部分字号下，当前高亮行缩放后被左右可见边界截断的问题。
- 横屏和竖屏歌词行均预留缩放安全区，保持现有高亮、点击预览和滚动定位行为。

### 安装

本版本与 Aurora 1.8.85-aurora.2 使用相同签名，可直接覆盖升级。若已安装原版
LX-N Music 或其他同包名但签名不同的版本，请先导出重要数据、卸载旧版后再安装。

## English

This is an unofficial Aurora maintenance release based on
<code>souvenp/lx-netease-music-mobile</code>.

### Included

- Fixes active lyrics being clipped by the left and right visible bounds at
  certain font sizes after the highlight scale animation.
- Reserves scale-safe horizontal space in both portrait and landscape lyric
  views while preserving highlighting, tap preview, and scroll positioning.

### Installation

This build uses the same signing key as Aurora 1.8.85-aurora.2 and can update
it in place. If a stock LX-N Music build or another same-package build with a
different signature is installed, export important data and uninstall it before
installing this release.
